title: The Economist Just Dropped Its 2027 Cover... and It's Terrifying #shorts #economist
description:
The Economist just released The World Ahead 2027 cover, and it's dark: tanks, missiles, a forest on fire, a market crash, syringes and pills, an AI brain, the Kremlin, and the world's leaders lined up at the very top. But look at the corner: a crescent, a star and a rider on a camel. What are they trying to tell us? Tell me in the comments 👇

Cover art: The Economist, The World Ahead 2027, illustrated by Cleon Peterson; shown for commentary and discussion. Printed on the cover: Trump's final chapter, Artificial intelligence, After Iran, Climate change, Populism on the rise, Hollywood reboots. The magazine calls it its forecast of the trends for the year ahead; it has not explained the individual symbols.
Narration: vidIQ voiceover. Music: original, generated with vidIQ.
